changes.result: Production reuse preflight now emits a private preflight object carrying exact protocol, intent, artifact, result, and witness commitments instead of treating request-shaped JSON as authenticated reuse.
An existing-only ledger path authenticates supplied reuse against the exact current Complete record without creating the root, lock, key, state, generation, grant, or workspace effect.
A private non-Clone and non-serializable authorization binds store identity, semantic effect, generation, canonical record digest, exact result artifact, and witness.

Reservation revalidates the authorization and current Complete record before inserting the consumed grant; stale generation or record substitution fails with routine-production-reuse-preauthorization-stale before reservation mutation.
Existing-only open acquires the existing lock before directory enumeration, preventing atomic publication temporaries from being misclassified as unknown authority entries during concurrency.

Focused controls cover pre-open forgery, foreign Complete-record substitution, 64 repeated forgeries, exact max and max-plus-one behavior, both forged-versus-valid orders, generation race, reopen, replay, mutation, workspace zero-transition, and later exact reuse.
